title: Tip about a Russian intelligence officer hiding as a monk on Mount Athos

tellings.quote: Which was I'd been given a tip by a Greek very close to the president prime minister of Greece uh about a monk at Mount Athos who was actually a Russian intelligence officer who was big getting cover and changing his identity to go on a mission to the US on behalf of Russian intelligence

plain: In 1991, a Greek man very close to the Greek prime minister tipped off Ralph Larson, who tells it as part of his own intelligence work, that a monk at Mount Athos was really a Russian intelligence officer. According to Larson, speaking on Michels's show, the man was building a cover and changing his identity to go on a mission to the United States for Russian intelligence, and a file was kept on him.
